host.description: IP address or hostname to bind the server to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port for the HTTP server to listen on.

webdir.description: Absolute filesystem path to the directory containing files to serve and accept uploads to.

ssl.description: HTTPS/TLS settings. Enable only if you have a valid SSL certificate.

cert_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format).

key_path.description: Absolute path to the SSL private key file (PEM format).

max_upload_size.description: Maximum file upload size in bytes (e.g., 10485760 = 10 MiB). Set to 0 for unlimited.

dir_listing.description: If true, display a directory listing when accessing a directory URL.

auth_method.description: Authentication method for uploads: 'none' (no auth), 'basic', or 'digest'.

auth_users.description: List of users allowed to upload (used only when auth_method is 'basic' or 'digest').

password.description: Password (plaintext in config — secure via file permissions and TLS).

description.description: Optional human-readable description (stored in config as comment).

allowed_mimetypes.description: List of allowed MIME types for uploads (e.g., ['text/plain', 'image/png']). Leave empty to allow all.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log to stderr instead.

cors.description: If true, add 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' header (for browser-based upload forms from other origins).

html_header.description: Optional raw HTML to inject into the <head> section of the web interface (e.g., custom styles or scripts).

html_footer.description: Optional raw HTML to inject just before </body> (e.g., tracking scripts or notices).
